title: Tequila Tini
steps: Rim the serving glass with smoked salt. Add lime juice, smoked orange juice, agave, Cointreau and tequila to a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a mini shaker tin to serve.
sourceNote: Adapted from Fork & Fire cocktail recipes.
reviewFlags: The source does not explain how to prepare smoked orange juice.
headnote: The source does not explain how to prepare smoked orange juice.
